notes.title: Corbid! A Colorful Adventure to premiere demo at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Corbid! A Colorful Adventure is a charming 3D platformer for all ages. Developed by CuCurry and published by Meridiem Games. Immerse yourself in this thrilling and colorful adventure, help Corbid overcome challenging mazes, and secure his place as the champion. Get ready to have fun as you embark on this mission full of color and excitement, where you'll need to use your skill and abilities to solve intricate puzzles in the two enormous gardens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108469/659f3096e9604881cbaa96ef101f3d2ed407ebee.jpg[/img]

Corbid! A Colorful Adventure will feature an exclusive free demo available during the upcoming Steam Next Fest, from February 5th to 12th, starting at 7:00 PM (Peninsular Time).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108469/6994b3a0e78dc973611a9e4bbb91dacdf65ff7c2.png[/img]

Features:
 [list]
[*]    Have fun helping Corbid navigate mazes to become the champion. Eat, mix, and shoot colors to solve puzzles in the 2 enormous gardens.
[*]     Defeat terrifying final bosses in entertaining challenges, where you'll need to outsmart them with intelligence and skill.
[*]     Enjoy colorful worlds full of creatures with different abilities that you'll need to manipulate to progress and unravel the mysteries within the gardens.
[*]     Find adventure companions on your journey who will assist you in completing fun scenarios and being more effective against dangers. Combine abilities to achieve unique movements and solve more complex puzzles. Above all, make friends!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=ZpL5E56WEwA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Come and meet Corbid at IndieDev!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Do you know who is coming to IndiDev?

Corbid! A Colorful Adventure is presented for the first time in an event and it comes from Meridiem Games, which will be very present in this new edition, sponsoring the B2B Area and participating actively with the Indie Dev Day staff. In addition, you will not only have the opportunity to try this nice 3D platform game, you will also be accompanied by titles such as The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo or Neon Blood. 

Have fun helping Corbid to overcome the mazes to be crowned champion. Eat, mix and shoot colors to solve the puzzles of the 2 large gardens. Defeat the terrifying final bosses in fun tests where you will have to overcome them in intelligence and dexterity.

A game for everyone, from the little ones with the help of their parents, the youngsters who want to have fun Corbid, to the older ones who want a challenge in the puzzles.

Take advantage and come and meet Corbid! and the great team behind the game. The fair will be in Barcelona on the 8th, 9th and 10th of September. It will take place in La Farga, located in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, in an impressive exhibition space of 8500m2. and the great team behind the videogame. 

The Spanish fair is going to be bigger, more diverse and better than ever, you can't miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108469/5d7bc0caf4622cd1acefc558d435b59a9afceab5.jpg[/img]

See you soon!
